title: Don't Look
description: Structured in an intense close-up crop, Don't Look focuses on the upper face, forehead, and averted gaze of a blonde woman. By shifting the figure's eyes away from the viewer, the painting creates an atmospheric tension between exposure and concealment, presence and self-protection. Rooted in visual explorations of intimacy, vulnerability, and internal dialogue, the artwork uses expressive brushwork and nuanced color tones to evoke a quiet, reflective emotional state.
